name: R100-ai-clefable-metronome-weather-ball-cloud-nine
why: Challenge 7. The AI's Clefable (389) opposite the player's Golduck 418 (Cloud Nine; Light Screen, slot 3, played 16 turns; Hydro Pump / Dig are never used) then Salamence 753 (Aerial Ace, never misses). Every AI Metronome call is a draw of one of the 336 callable moves; Weather Ball while Cloud Nine is on the field leaves it a 50-power Normal move (the weather-has-no-effect arm, any weather or none). About 8 AI Metronome calls a battle. Chance per seed about 8/336 = 2.4%.
